name: Hotel
description: A hotel is an establishment that provides lodging, meals, and other services to travelers and tourists. Hotels can range from budget accommodations to luxury resorts, offering various amenities such as room service, fitness centers, swimming pools, and conference facilities. They are typically located in popular tourist destinations, business districts, or near transportation hubs.
